title: Universal factorization before Stein connectedness
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a universally closed and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Put $B=H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and factor $f$ as $X\xrightarrow{q}\operatorname{Spec}B\xrightarrow{s}\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-pbc-stein-factorization]. Then $q$ is universally closed, quasi-compact, quasi-separated, and surjective; $s$ is integral; $q_*\mathcal O_X=\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}B}$; and this factorization is the relative spectrum of $f_*\mathcal O_X$ and commutes with flat base change.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 37.53.4 (Tag 03GY, label lemma-stein-universally-closed, line 15087), clauses (1)--(5) and proof
